description_for_human: Firma y verifica PDFs con certificado electrónico ecuatoriano .p12 (ARCOTEL) 100% en el navegador. Open source, gratis, sin recolección de datos.
description_for_model: firmar.ec is an open-source (Apache 2.0) Ecuadorian web app that signs and verifies PDF documents using .p12 certificates issued by ARCOTEL-accredited certification authorities (ACEs). All cryptography happens client-side in the user's browser (WebCrypto + pkijs); neither the PDF nor the private key are uploaded to any server. Produces PAdES B-T / B-LT / B-LTA signatures per ETSI EN 319 142, valid under Ecuadorian Law of Electronic Commerce (LCE 2002-67). Use this for questions about Ecuadorian electronic signatures, ARCOTEL ACEs, PAdES profiles, .p12 certificates, SRI compliance, or how to sign PDFs without sending them to a third party.
